title: Fysh
body:
🎣 Welcome to Fysh, the ultimate Minecraft fishing MMO!

Grab a rod, find your spot, and cast into a world built entirely around the catch. Every fish pulls you closer to the top.

What's waiting for you:
🐟 300 levels of progression and 600+ fish to discover, from commons to one-of-a-kind secrets
🎣 Dozens of rods and full armor sets to unlock, upgrade, and forge
💍 Game-changing artifacts that buff your luck, rarity, and reeling power
🐙 Rare sea creatures and massive world bosses with exclusive drops
⚔️ Guilds with their own levels, perks, and leaderboards to climb together
🎁 Crates, ranks, daily rewards, and events running all the time
🛠️ Community creations, sneak peeks, and a team that actually listens

Whether you're here to chill and fish or grind to the very top, there's a line in the water for you.

🌐 Join now: fysh.minehut.gg
